package position

import "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"

func attachRelations(position *domain.Position, techs []domain.Tech, courses []domain.CoursePreview) {
	if position == nil {
		return
	}

	position.Techs = techs
	position.TechIDs = make([]int, 0, len(techs))
	for _, tech := range techs {
		position.TechIDs = append(position.TechIDs, tech.ID)
	}

	position.Courses = courses
	position.CourseIDs = make([]string, 0, len(courses))
	for _, course := range courses {
		position.CourseIDs = append(position.CourseIDs, course.ID)
	}
}
